metas.name: Miracles of the ER
metas.description: A bold decision brings an average med student to an elite ER team, where he encounters medical crises, ethical dilemmas, and personal growth.

metas.name: The goop Guide with Gwyneth Paltrow
metas.description: Gwyneth Paltrow welcomes celebrities, artists, entrepreneurs and experts for candid conversations about wellness, relationships, personal growth and everyday life, exploring fresh perspectives and the experiences that shape us.

metas.name: Alicia's Law
metas.description: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

metas.name: ChiaroScuro
metas.description: After a body is found in a Roman museum, an art expert must apply his instincts and skills to help police solve a mystery connected to his own past.

metas.name: The Body
metas.description: On Halloween night, an all-girls dance squad tumbles into Catholic guilt, unholy desires and ghostly visions when an initiation goes to hell.

metas.name: Doozie's Doghouse
metas.description: Make it a doghouse day! Dog-loving Doozie uses her creativity and imagination during playtime with her puppy pals.

metas.name: Under Siege
metas.description: Caught in the crossfire, hostages, militaries and guerrillas are swept into a tragedy that brings turmoil to Colombia.

metas.name: Taken: Natalee Holloway
metas.description: Beth Holloway, Natalee's mother, tells the full, definitive story of the case that's haunted her for the past 20 years - from the day of Natalee's disappearance to the dramatic confession two decades later.

metas.name: Anaesthesia
metas.description: After a bold but unsuccessful surgery, a talented doctor swaps a prestigious clinic for a local hospital as he tries to get his life back on track.

metas.name: Bass X Machina
metas.description: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

metas.name: How to Ruin Diwali: Meet the Parents
metas.description: When overachieving perfectionist Mmabatho Nkomo meets her fiancé’s traditional Indian family for the first time, her desperate attempt to make a good impression goes badly wrong. She accidentally exposes her future father-in-law’s secret affair. With Diwali only days away, Mmabatho must navigate unfamiliar cultural territory and try to reunite the family she has torn apart — without creating even more chaos.

metas.name: A Couple of Lies
metas.description: A seemingly idyllic home swap between Sicily and Stockholm turns toxic as two wealthy couples go to extremes to protect themselves — and their secrets.

metas.name: Obsess
metas.description: After returning home, Talal is pulled into a dark psychological journey where the lines between guilt, desire and his own disturbing impulses begin to blur. As buried feelings connected to a past love resurface, the darkness inside him grows stronger. Talal is forced to confront a terrifying question: can he free himself from his past, or will it consume him completely?

metas.name: Dead-End Job
metas.description: Drowning in debt, a young man takes lucrative part-time jobs from a mysterious agency — only to find his hustle for more money turning nightmarish.

metas.name: Akka
metas.description: In a kingdom ruled by women, matriarch Bhavani faces her biggest threat in Rudra, a ruthless rebel eyeing her land and legacy.

metas.name: The Fall of El Mayo
metas.description: Co-founder of the Sinaloa Cartel, longtime partner of "El Chapo", and a ghost to authorities for over three decades. The documentary that tells the story of his downfall.

metas.name: Balaraw: Blood Island
metas.description: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

metas.name: The Gift of Deceit
metas.description: Desperate to find a cure for the unknown illness affecting her daughter, art collector Lúcia Rossetti turns to a spiritual healer. When Lúcia falls victim to a scam, a series of secrets is revealed, intertwining two families marked by love, control, resentment, and guilt.

metas.name: The One About Matthew Perry
metas.description: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

metas.name: Minimum Wage
metas.description: Teens struggle to run a local pizzeria while juggling school, a manic boss and minimum wage in this series based on the hit social media shorts.

metas.name: Fading Grandeur
metas.description: Desperate to sell his crumbling mansion, a fallen marquis tries to make a quick deal with a charming yet mysterious millionaire who has her own agenda.

metas.name: Couldn't Agree Less with Allison & Isaac
metas.description: Real-life couple Allison Kuch and Isaac Rochell invite viewers into their messiest, most honest disagreements — tackling everything from money and parenting to jealousy and in-laws through audience submissions, guest perspectives, and pop culture debates.

metas.name: Did Someone Happen to Mention Me?
metas.description: Once Japan's most renowned actor, Gen is suddenly forgotten. Fueled by a need for recognition, he claws his way back from zero in this comedy.

metas.name: The New Stanford Prison Experiment
metas.description: In this modern reimagining of the infamous study, 30 people enter a real prison for two weeks and shifting power dynamics expose what they're capable of.

metas.name: Driving Mom Crazy
metas.description: After criminals kidnap her baby, overwhelmed new mom Ruyi Zhang joins an unlikely crew of gangsters, ghosts and deities for a frantic rescue mission.

metas.name: Money Trap
metas.description: When a mythical map falls into the hands of a legendary scam artist, he decides to pull one last con before leaving it all behind for good.

metas.name: The Great Hang-jun
metas.description: Acclaimed director Jang Hang-jun secretly auditions top Korean actors for a film about his own life in this cheeky cinematic talk show.

metas.name: Hollywood Arts
metas.description: Class is in session at Hollywood Arts! Self-proclaimed icon Trina Vega returns to steer gifted teens toward stardom, status and hilarious havoc.

metas.name: Alas Roban: The Series
metas.description: When her husband vanishes on a perilous road, a mortuary worker uncovers a sinister pattern of deaths while working to secure her daughter's eye surgery.

metas.name: TYSON
metas.description: This gripping four-part documentary series explores the explosive life of Mike Tyson — one of the most feared and fascinating figures in sports history.

metas.name: The Trap
metas.description: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

metas.name: Least Eligible Bachelor
metas.description: A bachelor struggling to find a bride because of his looks moves to Hyderabad for a fresh start, only to discover that his potential match is his colleague at work.

metas.name: A Day Like No Other
metas.description: The origins, career and music of Spanish singer Raphael inspire this intimate biopic series about his remarkable journey to 60 years of global success.

metas.name: Take Charge of My Heart
metas.description: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

metas.name: Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

metas.name: Inside the Circle
metas.description: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

metas.name: #Love
metas.description: The pragmatic creator of a dating app and her adventurous competitor test their theories about love in a 60-day challenge to find their ideal partner.

metas.name: Sam and Colby: Paranormal Investigators
metas.description: Best friends Sam and Colby visit some of the world’s most haunted locations in search of paranormal evidence, trying to answer one question: Are ghosts real?

metas.name: Your Personal Taxi
metas.description: In an unusual taxi, passengers open up about their lives, sharing personal stories alongside songs that hold special meaning to them.

metas.name: East of Eden
metas.description: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

metas.name: The Arena
metas.description: Ciryl Gane, Cédric Doumbè and Benoît Saint Denis put 38 amateur fighters through brutal trials and cage fights to win €100,000 and a professional MMA contract.

metas.name: Love Is Blind: Netherlands
metas.description: The hit dating experiment lands in the Netherlands, where a group of Dutch singles date, fall in love and get engaged, all before meeting face-to-face.

metas.name: The Other Side
metas.description: Three years after her son mysteriously disappeared, a grieving mother begins experiencing disturbing visions that seem impossible to explain. When mirrors appear to reveal cracks between her reality and another parallel world, she becomes convinced that the truth about her son's disappearance may exist on the other side. As memories, hallucinations and reality begin to overlap, she is drawn into a dangerous mystery that also exposes hidden fractures within her marriage and family.

metas.name: LEGO ONE PIECE
metas.description: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

metas.name: Last Trace with Kaelyn Moore
metas.description: Every case leaves something behind: a grainy frame, a timestamp, a witness who swears they saw something. Last Trace is a weekly show that follows the record to the precise point where it goes cold, and asks what got missed the first time.

metas.name: Outside
metas.description: Going beyond the four walls, Outside is the latest spin-off from the Sidemen's smash-hit series Inside. A new group of content creators are thrown into the forest to battle for a prize of up to £1 million. With every comfort eating into the prize pot, they'll face brutal decisions, unpredictable challenges and plenty of Sidemen mischief as they fight to keep hold of the cash.

metas.name: OUTLORE with Eleanor Neale
metas.description: British storyteller Eleanor Neale unpacks the world’s most compelling true-crime cases, while raising awareness and building a community around the stories that matter.

metas.name: The Final Problem
metas.description: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

metas.name: Delusion
metas.description: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

metas.name: My Sad Dead
metas.description: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

metas.name: A Different World
metas.description: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

metas.name: Shaque: Trust No One
metas.description: A mother receives yearly photos of her missing child. After nine years of searching, she discovers the truth about the abduction lies not far away, but hidden among her closest circle.

metas.name: Habeas Corpus
metas.description: A renowned law professor and a team of students attempt to prove the innocence of a convicted man, but the brightest student is secretly connected to his past.

metas.name: Wonka's The Golden Ticket
metas.description: In this one-of-a-kind reality competition, lucky players step inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory to face unpredictable games, tests and temptations.

metas.name: Minerva Academy
metas.description: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

metas.name: SML
metas.description: SML, formerly SuperMarioLogan, offers funny puppet comedy, wild characters, and entertaining stories for comedy fans.

metas.name: Pote
metas.description: A young medical team is sent to Marunda Island to investigate a mysterious skin disease that has terrified the locals. However, the deeper they delve, the more they realize the outbreak is merely a symptom of an ancient curse linked to the Forbidden Lake and a terrifying entity known as Oreng Pote. As human transgressions reawaken a long-dormant terror, the team must choose between logic, guilt, and the supernatural forces that target anyone who witnesses death.

metas.name: The Scandal
metas.description: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

metas.name: Rescapé : La Série
metas.description: In the northern districts of Marseille, Soso navigates the world of drug trafficking amidst friendships, rivalries, and betrayals. Inspired by the early life of Soso Maness—who plays the lead role—the series chronicles the choices and trials that shaped his journey.

metas.name: Not a Stranger
metas.description: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

metas.name: The Fixers
metas.description: A washed-up gangster reluctantly teams up with an arrogant political heir to become "fixers", cleaning up dangerous secrets for both sides of the law.

metas.name: Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story
metas.description: Trapped in a cruel Victorian-era household, Lizzie Borden kills her parents in a gory ax murder that shocks the nation.

metas.name: Plastic Beauty
metas.description: When a gifted ER surgeon is thrust into cosmetic medicine, her clash with a celebrity doctor exposes the greed and desire beneath the glamour.

metas.name: Physical 100: Mexico
metas.description: Reality competition show based on the original Korean format.

metas.name: The Doll
metas.description: When Stanisław falls in love with the aristocratic Izabela, he dedicates his entire life to winning her over.

metas.name: Istri Satu-Satunya
metas.description: The story follows Soraya (Clara Bernadeth), a young woman living a simple life with her mother, Nina (Unique Priscilla). Everything changes on Nina’s birthday when a wealthy, powerful businessman named Pierre (Adipura) unexpectedly resurfaces. Pierre was long presumed dead by Soraya, but he suddenly appears claiming to be Nina's husband. Shocked by his return, Nina collapses and suffers medical trauma, losing parts of her memory.

metas.name: Kudrat 1968: High Council
metas.description: Abbas enrolls at KUDRAT, an institution bearing his estranged father's name, where a troubling history forces him to confront a legacy he never wanted.

metas.name: Stolen Heartbeats
metas.description: After an attack leaves a woman named Anabel comatose, she and Rafael—a nurse who has the unique ability to hear the dead—must work together to keep her alive while hiding from her enemies.

metas.name: Physical 100: Italy
metas.description: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges, each battling to outlast the rest and claim the glory of becoming the one true champion.

metas.name: Mythical Kitchen
metas.description: Mythical Chef Josh and his team of Kitcheneers cook unexpected dishes, share meals with celebrity guests, tackle crazy culinary challenges and more.

metas.name: The Perfect Lie
metas.description: When one of their own is killed in a house fire, four picture-perfect couples are forced to question everything they thought they knew about each other.

metas.name: Chumbak
metas.description: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

metas.name: Crew Girl
metas.description: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

metas.name: Dang!
metas.description: After their sister Ruthie blows up her perfect life, Andrew and Eunice show her the fun in being flawed as she helps them adult.

metas.name: KL2
metas.description: Kevin Langue and his friends turn childish games into pure, chaotic fun.

metas.name: The Kevin Langue Show
metas.description: Kevin Langue and his friends put their people-reading skills to the test, questioning a lineup of contestants to try and find the secret liar.

metas.name: On Campus: Game of the Week
metas.description: Every week at a different school, go inside campus life with real college students from the lead-up to the aftermath of college football's biggest games.

metas.name: Earle Meets World
metas.description: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

metas.name: Lovesick
metas.description: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

metas.name: All the Truth in My Lies
metas.description: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

metas.name: Mousetrap
metas.description: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

metas.name: The Martha Stewart Podcast
metas.description: Martha Stewart talks with leaders, entertainers and visionaries at the top of their game — and they've never encountered an interviewer quite like her.

metas.name: Mom Knows Best?
metas.description: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.
